description: 3 should-trigger + 3 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers discovery of an unknown codebase, resolving the real framework versions and mapping the execution flow, and a German phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (a known-framework analysis, a root-cause hunt on an isolated bug) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: this codebase is unknown to me, discover its structure and architecture first
resolve the real framework versions and map the execution flow of this project
ich kenne das Projekt nicht, ermittle Versionen und Architektur
analyze this Laravel app's service container setup
queries.note: the framework is already known; project-analysis-laravel goes directly

queries.q: why does this one endpoint return 500 only in staging?
queries.note: an isolated issue needs root-cause analysis, not discovery

queries.q: rename the variable total to grandTotal

I'm taking over this repository next week and nobody who built it is still around. Before I change anything, give me the lay of the land: what it's built with, how the parts fit together, and what happens from the moment a request comes in.

Our security review needs to know exactly which versions of the runtime, the frameworks and the main libraries this project runs on, and how a request travels through it. Work it out from the repo and flag anything you couldn't pin down.
